question: Which parts of LLM mental-health support behavior can be checked by an exact or documented rule verifier, and how well do two LLM judges agree with those verifiers on fictional replies?
evidence_tier: exploratory, synthetic fixtures only; no prospective claim, no clinical validity claim
independent_units: task (one fictional item-response vector, one fictional user message, or one fictional reply). Repeated measurement of the same task by two policies or two judges is nested under the task.

fixtures.instrument_tasks: 24 fictional PHQ-9 and GAD-7 item-response vectors (12 each), 4 incomplete, half with cutpoints stated in the prompt
fixtures.safety_tasks: 16 fictional user messages: 8 crisis cues, 8 no-risk controls
fixtures.transcripts: 24 hand-written fictional replies: 8 safety, 8 validation, 8 thought record; half clear and half subtle; label by construction, one author

verifiers.instrument_scoring: exact: total, severity band, item 9 follow-up flag, incomplete status
verifiers.safety_rules: lexical proxy, rules R1 to R5 for crisis cues, P1 for controls
verifiers.validation_rules: lexical proxy, rules V1 and V2
verifiers.thought_record_rules: lexical proxy, rules T1 and T2
verifiers.freeze: scripts/checkers.py is frozen at this commit. Rule changes after outcomes are a new version.

subjects.route: plan router, read-only native jobs, free of platform credits
subjects.excluded: no paid API, no GPU job, no training, no RL
subjects.substitute_claude: Claude Code subagent on the platform allowance, reading only a blinded copy of the prompt file

E1_verifier_controls: Exact instrument verifier accepts 24 of 24 gold answers and rejects 24 of 24 field-corrupted copies (probability 0.99, by construction).
Lexical checkers versus construction labels: accuracy on the 12 clear transcripts at least 0.90 (probability 0.70) and on the 12 subtle transcripts at most 0.75 (probability 0.70).
E2_anarres_flow: anarres measure accepts one profile input per candidate environment and subject, and anarres design reports the candidates compatible under one subject (probability 0.85).
Both policies pass at least 0.90 of valid instrument tasks (probability 0.75), so instrument scoring is near ceiling and carries little selection signal.
Lexical crisis-cue pass fraction is lower than the instrument pass fraction for both policies (probability 0.75).
E3_judge_agreement: Each LLM judge matches the construction label on at least 0.85 of the 24 transcripts (probability 0.70).
Judge versus judge Cohen kappa is at least 0.70 (probability 0.65).
Judge versus lexical-rule kappa is below judge versus judge kappa for both judges (probability 0.75).
At least 70 percent of judge errors fall on subtle transcripts (probability 0.65).

reporting_rules: separate unparseable or failed runs (infrastructure) from scientific failures
name route, harness, and model for every model call
chronology: freeze this protocol and the checkers
run verifier controls on gold and corrupted answers
run both policies on instrument and safety tasks
export profile inputs and run the native CLI
run both judges on the 24 transcripts with an identical rubric prompt
write RESULTS.md with each prediction marked met, missed, or untested

amendments.reason: vals-claude returned HTTP 429 (individual spend limit) on its only job; recorded as an infrastructure failure, not a scientific result. No other Claude route was available.
amendments.change: Claude-family subject and judge: a Claude Code subagent (model ID as it reports) replaces vals-claude. Grok jobs ran on personal-grok (grok-4.7) before this amendment was committed; their outputs had been saved but not scored.
